title: Fast localized urban microclimate emulator: wind and temperatures in unseen urban morphologies
abstract: arXiv:2503.19708v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Urban microclimate, encompassing wind and temperature fields shaped by building geometry, strongly affects building energy use, pedestrian wind comfort, pollutant dispersion, the urban heat island, and public health. Conventional Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) is computationally prohibitive for rapid assessments, while many deep learning approaches require extensive training data and struggle with generalization to unseen configurations. translated_title: 快速局地城市微气候模拟器：未见城市形态下的风场与温度场预测
translated_abstract: 城市微气候，包括由建筑几何形状塑造的风场和温度场，强烈影响着建筑能耗、行人风舒适度、污染物扩散、城市热岛效应以及公共健康。传统计算流体力学（CFD）方法在快速评估方面计算成本过高，而许多深度学习方法则需要大量训练数据，且难以泛化到未见过的城市配置。在本工作中，我们提出了快速局地城市微气候模拟器（FLUME），这是一个基于傅里叶神经算子的快速、数据高效且感知几何信息的框架，用于预测三维风场和温度场。FLUME假设在给定入流条件和热强迫下，这些平均场的空间变化很大程度上由周围建筑几何形状所控制。该框架引入了多方向距离特征（MDDF），用于在……范围内捕获建筑几何信息。
tldr: 本文提出基于傅里叶神经算子的快速局地城市微气候模拟器FLUME，通过引入多方向距离特征（MDDF）编码建筑几何信息，实现了数据高效、可泛化到未见城市形态的三维风场与温度场快速预测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes FLUME, a fast and data-efficient urban microclimate emulator based on the Fourier neural operator, which introduces a Multi-Directional Distance Feature (MDDF) to encode building geometry, enabling rapid prediction of 3D wind and temperature fields that generalizes to unseen urban morphologies.
